About SEC Business Group
SEC Business Group Pty Ltd is an established engineering, fabrication, and industrial services company
based in Adelaide, South Australia. We specialise in conveyor systems, mechanical engineering, fabrication, and project services

About the Role
Our client, SEC Business Group, is seeking a skilled Metal Fabricator to join their team in Adelaide, South Australia. In this role, you will be responsible for fabricating, assembling, repairing, and maintaining metal components and structures in workshop
operations.

Key Responsibilities
Fabricate, assemble, and weld metal parts and structures based on technical drawings and specifications
Repair and modify agricultural machinery, plant equipment, and structural components
Perform welding, cutting, grinding, shaping, and finishing of metal materials 
Interpret engineering drawings, blueprints, and fabrication plans
Carry out maintenance and repair work on machinery and workshop equipment
Assist in installation and fitting of new equipment and machinery upgrades
Inspect completed work to ensure compliance with quality and safety standards
Support preventative maintenance activities across farm and workshop operations
Maintain tools, equipment, and fabrication workspace in safe working condition
Collaborate with mechanics, technicians, and farm operations staff

Requirements
Trade qualification in Metal Fabrication, Boilermaking, or equivalent
Proven experience in fabrication, welding, or metalwork in industrial or agricultural settings
Strong welding skills (MIG, TIG, and/or ARC preferred)
Ability to read and interpret technical drawings and specifications
Good understanding of workplace health and safety standards
Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality workmanship
Ability to work independently and as part of a team
Physically fit and able to work in a hands-on environment


What We Offer
Competitive salary package
Stable full-time role in a growing agricultural operation
Hands-on and varied workshop environment
Opportunities for skills development and training
Supportive and safety-focused team culture
Long-term career stability in the agricultural sector

result.description:
On behalf of our  client DHM Precision Engineering are seeking a qualified Fitter General, Fitter/Machinist for a full-time position in Malaga.

The salary range is from $80,000 to $85,000 per year plus super. 

Primary responsibilities Machinist
•     Operate machine tools such as lathes, milling machines,
•     Manufacture rods, glands, pistons, barrels, bases, fittings, bushes
•     Review specifications for a job.
•     Calculate where to cut or bore.
•     Shape steel, aluminium, other materials.
•     Determine how fast or slow workpiece is fed into machine.
•     Determine how much material to remove.
•     Select tools and materials for the job.
•     Plan the sequence of cutting and finishing operations.
•     Mark the workpiece to show where cuts should be made.
•     Position workpiece on the lathe or milling machine.
•     Monitor and control feed rate and speed.
•     Ensure workpiece is properly lubricated and/or cooled.
•     Regulate temperature of workpiece.
•     Detect problems by listening for specific sounds.
•     Adjust cutting speed to compensate for harmonic vibrations.
•     Monitor the accuracy of cuts.
•     Replace dull cutting tools.
•     Check accuracy of work against specifications.
•     Ability to use precision tools (eg. Micrometers internal & external)
•     Use manual machinery.

Primary responsibilities Fitter
 
•     Takes the components assemble together, barrel, rod, piston and gland, assemble, to make a complete cylinder
•     Seal assembly
•     Then test cylinder, make sure has no leaks, by- pass pressure test, close it up, plug and press in the bushes
•     Record the testing
•     ID cylinder with job number
•     Completed cylinder for spraying
•     Torque nuts and bolts to right specifications
•     Press the bushes

Qualifications/Knowledge/Skills/Experience
 
•     Certificate Ill in Engineering - Mechanical Trade (Fitter & Machinist)
•     Good mechanical aptitude.
•     Excellent reading comprehension
•     Physical Stamina

if you have the required qualifications and experience and are looking to advance your career with a respected engineering business.

PERSOL  is one of Australia's largest and longest-serving recruitment providers. Delivering both temporary and permanent workforce solutions, we specialise in the recruitment of Engineering, Technical, and Office Support talent.    We are currently partnered with a well-known mining company to recruit an  Open Pit Geotechnical Engineer . This is a great opportunity to progress your career with a respected player in the mining industry.     Role Details:    
 
 Immediate start 
 6+ month contract possibility to go fulltime 
 8/6 roster | 10-hour days 
 DIDO Boddington (must stay onsite during roster; only locals can DIDO daily) 
 Competitive day rate | Weekly pay 
 
  Key Responsibilities:    
 
 Provide advice on operations related to pit development and pit wall scaling activities 
 Conduct daily open pit inspections and waste dump inspections 
 Contribute to evaluating and implementing changes to design and work procedures within the Plan-Do-Check-Act cycle 
 Implement geotechnical and technical standards, ensuring compliance across all outputs 
 Carry out office-based geotechnical tasks as required 
 
  Requirements:    
 
 Bachelor's degree in Mining Engineering, Geological Engineering, or Geology with postgraduate qualifications in Geomechanics 
 Proficiency with 3D modelling software (e.g., GEM4D, Minesight, Vulcan, Deswik) 
 Experience using geotechnical software (e.g., Rocscience Suite, Trajec3D) 
 Ideally 5+ years' experience as an Open Pit Geotechnical Engineer, including exposure to slope stability radars 
 Must have Australian Driver's License/Vehicle 
 
 If you're interested in this role, click  Apply Now  and we'll be in touch as soon as possible.  For further information, please contact  Shannon Bromfield  via  Shannon.Bromfield@persolapac.com
